title: Importing a large CSV is very slow
body: A 2 GB CSV takes over two hours to import. CPU is idle. How can I speed up the import?
author: asker

answers.body:
The default batch size is 50, so you spend most of the time on round trips. Increase it and import in parallel:

```java
OrbitClient client = OrbitClient.builder()
    .batchSize(500)
    .parallelism(4)
    .build();
client.importCsv(Path.of("customers.csv"));
```

On our data this cut the import from 2h to 11 minutes.
answers.author: li
